criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: General Knowledge Query
categories.definition: User asks for facts, definitions, instructions, recommendations, or general information not specific to their personal accounts or data.

categories.name: Personal Data Query
categories.definition: User asks for specific information related to their personal accounts, status, or data.

categories.name: Scheduling & Reminders
categories.definition: User wants to create, modify, or query calendar events, reminders, or personal lists.

categories.name: Navigation & Location
categories.definition: User asks for directions, current location, or information about nearby places or lost items.

categories.name: Media Control
categories.definition: User wants to play, search for, or control media such as music, videos, or photos.

categories.name: Device & Assistant Settings
categories.definition: User wants to change device settings, assistant preferences, or control the assistant's own behavior.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: User wants to send messages, make calls, or inform others.

categories.name: Financial Transactions & Account Management
categories.definition: User wants to initiate financial transactions, manage account features, or pay bills.

categories.name: Shopping & Purchasing
categories.definition: User wants to purchase items, find products, or order goods.

categories.name: Reservations & Bookings
categories.definition: User wants to make, cancel, or inquire about reservations for travel, dining, or other services.

categories.name: Assistant Interaction Management
categories.definition: User provides feedback, asks for repetition, makes meta-comments about the interaction, or controls the interaction flow.

categories.name: System & Application Management
categories.definition: User wants to manage applications, files, or system processes.

categories.name: Random & Game Actions
categories.definition: User asks the assistant to perform a random action, play a simple game, or tell a joke.

categories.name: External System Interaction
categories.definition: User wants to interact with another smart assistant or external system via the current assistant.

categories.name: Problem Statement / Implied Need
categories.definition: User describes a problem or situation, implying a need for assistance or further action from the assistant.
